fusions.name: Flung Scree
fusions.desc: Rakes the lash across the ground and flings 4 shards in a spread out to 6 tiles; each deals 8 damage and knocks its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Split the Boulder
fusions.desc: Cracks a stone-weighted tip into the first enemy it meets, which deals 30 damage, then bursts into shards, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Anchored in Bedrock
fusions.desc: Anchors the lash in the ground, and your armour rises by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Flint Popper
fusions.desc: Conjures a flint tip for your lash: your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 15% more damage, each kill restores 3 health, and your armour rises by 5%.
